title: Specialist dispositions and integration qualification

original_contracts.title: Decide Betterleaks and write its comparison protocol
original_contracts.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_contracts.output: Decision record for stable v1.9.0 versus Gitleaks, exact permissions, metrics and reopen condition.
original_contracts.done_evidence: Credential validation explicitly off; v2 migration/env/flag changes need separate qualification; comparison execution scheduled only after preservation.

original_contracts.title: Decide Trivy against a demonstrated coverage gap
original_contracts.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_contracts.output: Adopt/pilot/defer record for container/OS/IaC needs, provenance/digests and telemetry/version/DB/module/VEX/registry/egress controls.
original_contracts.done_evidence: Incident-informed release trust and exact permissions are resolved before selection; do not duplicate baseline tools without useful gain.

original_contracts.title: Decide AgentShield on sanitized selected configuration
original_contracts.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_contracts.output: Local-only adopt/pilot/defer record with explicit file boundaries and maintenance/reopen conditions.
original_contracts.done_evidence: No Opus/injection/deep/sandbox/repair/runtime hooks, online lookup, home discovery or raw-content model path; other modes require distinct authority/redesign.

original_contracts.title: Build the selected disabled Betterleaks challenger
original_contracts.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_contracts.output: Pinned adapter and positive/negative/validation-off fixtures matching the comparison protocol.
original_contracts.done_evidence: Only selected frozen authorized implementation is built; remains disabled; no comparison has run yet.
original_contracts.condition: Betterleaks implementation selected and authorized before S06 freeze

original_contracts.title: Build the selected disabled Trivy adapter
original_contracts.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_contracts.output: Gap-scoped adapter, exact offline/config controls and provenance/egress fixtures.
original_contracts.done_evidence: Only selected frozen authorized implementation is built; no broad duplicated scans or implied adoption.
original_contracts.condition: Trivy implementation selected and authorized before S06 freeze

original_contracts.title: Build the selected disabled AgentShield adapter
original_contracts.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_contracts.output: Sanitized explicit-config adapter and restricted-mode fixtures.
original_contracts.done_evidence: Only selected frozen authorized implementation is built; prohibited deep/provider/raw-source modes cannot be enabled implicitly.
original_contracts.condition: AgentShield implementation selected and authorized before S06 freeze

original_contracts.title: Complete the optional decision ledger
original_contracts.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_contracts.output: decisions/ links prerequisites, selected/deferred scope, current binary/rule/database availability and verification receipts or missing-asset status, metric collection plan, version/maintenance limits and reopen conditions for all three candidates.
original_contracts.done_evidence: Decisions are evidence-backed without pretending benchmarks ran; deferred/unavailable evaluations remain NOT QUALIFIED and unchecked.

original_contracts.title: Accept the qualified sprint or retain an explicit hold
original_contracts.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_contracts.output: Independent sprint_qualification decision and five stage states; separate target acceptance.
original_contracts.done_evidence: Complete only with actual current full review, verified preservation and all applicable checks passed; otherwise unchecked (C05). Explicitly deferred pilot boxes may stay unchecked without blocking the documented baseline disposition.

original_contracts.title: Resolve supported findings and seal review outcome
original_contracts.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_contracts.output: Coherent corrections with independent re-review, or review-pending preservation receipt.

original_contracts.title: Freeze the complete sprint scope
original_contracts.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies

original_contracts.title: Seal the full implementation endpoint

original_contracts.title: Preserve eligible source immediately in the same draft

original_contracts.title: Reconcile and stage missing approved optional assets
original_contracts.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_contracts.output: Tool-specific binary/rule/database/provenance/license/digest and freshness receipts matching the approved Betterleaks, Trivy or AgentShield pins, from a separate acquisition area.
original_contracts.done_evidence: No scanner or target command executes during acquisition; existing verified assets need no refetch; missing permission/assets keep only the affected pilot unrun and disabled, never block code preservation or baseline deferral.
original_contracts.condition: A selected optional pilot needs an asset not already verified locally and that exact acquisition is separately authorized

original_contracts.title: Record independent full-diff review

original_contracts.title: Write the bounded rollback procedure

original_contracts.done_evidence: Exact reversible steps, retained evidence and resulting coverage state documented.

original_contracts.outcome_receipt_semantics: Requires current outcomes, including exact blocked/skipped/unrun/deferred receipts, not successful completion of validation boxes.
